Based on my search, I can provide you with information about **CFA Institute membership**. Here's a comprehensive overview:

## What is CFA Institute?

CFA Institute is the global professional organization that administers the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program, widely regarded as the premier credential in investment management and financial analysis.

---

## CFA Membership Types

### 1. **Regular Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals directly involved in or supporting the investment decision-making process
- **Requirements:**
  - Bachelor's degree or equivalent education/work experience
  - Passing score on Level I CFA Exam (or equivalent)
  - At least **4,000 hours of relevant work experience** completed in a minimum of 36 months
  - **2 professional references** (if one is an active regular member of your local CFA society) **OR 3 professional references** (if none are active members)
- **Benefits:** Voting rights for CFA Institute Board of Governor elections, access to research, continued professional learning, member directory, exclusive volunteer opportunities
- **Prerequisite for:** Earning the CFA charter

### 2. **Affiliate Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals who don't meet regular membership eligibility requirements
- **Requirements:** Passing score on Level I CFA Exam
- **Work experience:** Not required
- **Benefits:** Access to research, continued professional learning content, member directory, exclusive volunteer opportunities
- **No voting rights**

---

## CFA Membership Fees (2026)

| Fee Component | Amount |
|--------------|--------|
| **CFA Institute Annual Dues (Regular Member)** | **USD $299/year** |
| **Local Society Dues** | Varies by region (USD $50–$200/year) |
| **Professional Leave Reduced Rate** | Available with qualifying circumstances |

### Important Fee Changes for 2026:
- The **one-time $350 enrollment fee has been abolished** for new candidates registering for exams from February 2026 onwards
- Exam registration fees have been adjusted upward accordingly

---

## Exam Registration Fees (2026)

| Level | Early Registration | Standard Registration |
|-------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Level I & II | ~USD $1,100–$1,140 | ~USD $1,490–$1,500 |
| Level III | ~USD $1,200–$1,240 | ~USD $1,590–$1,600 |
| Rescheduling Fee | USD $250 | USD $250 |

---

## Requirements to Earn the CFA Charter

To become a **CFA charterholder**, you must:
1. ✅ Pass all 3 CFA exam levels (Level 1, 2, and 3)
2. ✅ Accumulate **4,000 hours of qualified work experience** over at least 36 months
3. ✅ Provide **2-3 professional references**
4. ✅ Sign the Ethics pledge
5. ✅ Apply for and maintain **CFA Institute Regular Membership**

---

## Maintaining Your Charter

- **Annual membership dues are mandatory** to maintain your charter and use the CFA designation
- If membership lapses, you lose the right to use "CFA" after your name
- You can reactivate by paying back dues—your charter isn't permanently lost
- Violations of the Code of Ethics can result in charter revocation

---

## CFA Society India Specifics

- CFA Society India now collects membership dues in **Indian Rupees (INR)**
- Membership year: **July 1 to June 30**
- Professional Leave status available with reduced dues using code **"PROFLEAVE"** for qualifying members
- Contact: membership@india.cfasociety.org

---

## Total Estimated CFA Journey Cost (2026)

| Scenario | Estimated Total Cost |
|----------|-------------------|
| Minimum (early registration, no retakes, no prep materials) | ~USD $3,570–$3,860 |
| Realistic (includes prep materials, possible retake) | USD $7,000–$9,500 |
| Maximum (multiple retakes, premium materials) | USD $12,000+ |

---

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://quintedge.com/blog/cfa-course-fee
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
7. https://rbeiset.com/cfa-course-2026-eligibility-fees-syllabus-career-scope/
8. https://proschoolonline.com/blog/cfa-enrollment-fees-update
